% ---- two columns ----
\begin{minipage}[t]{0.60\textwidth}
\IfFileExists{dtm-pcb.jpg}{%

    \parbox[c][4.2cm][c]{0.94\linewidth}{\centering\color{tpgray}\itshape[ Product image: NESL EMS PCB on stand-offs ]}}\end{center}}

\vspace{4pt}
{\small
\textbf{DTM-EMS} is the intelligent controller at the heart of the secondary distribution
transformer. It fuses transformer-grade polyphase precision metering ($\pm$0.1\%) with neutral,
phase and leakage insight, autonomous phase balancing and dynamic energy-policy enforcement, then
\textbf{networks with multiple open-source Street-EMS nodes on a shared LV feeder} to coordinate
the whole low-voltage network. Built on \textbf{open standards (IEEE, ISV, OpenAMI)}, it is the
open, future-proof brain of the grid edge.

\smallskip
\textbf{\color{tpdark}What Sets DTM-EMS Apart:}
\begin{arrows}
\item \textbf{Precision metering + leakage insight} : $\pm$0.1\% polyphase, with neutral, phase and AC/DC leakage measured directly (plus NILM).
\item \textbf{Autonomous phase balancing} : drives neutral current toward zero and cuts feeder losses, hands-off.
\item \textbf{Feeder-wide coordination} : networks open-source Street-EMS nodes on one LV feeder for front-of-meter rural and urban village microgrids.
\item \textbf{Front and behind the meter} : orchestrates behind-meter building EV charge / discharge and riser / balcony solar-and-battery.
\item \textbf{Open-Source Hardware} : released under CERN-OHL-S v2 --- schematics, board files
and firmware published on GitHub (meshEMS / X-EMS).
\item \textbf{Field-Serviceable} : built from open, off-the-shelf commodity modules, snap-in
mounted for fast in-country assembly and repair.
\end{arrows}

\smallskip
One open, outdoor-rated box turns the distribution transformer into the coordinating brain of a
feeder-wide microgrid, on standards you own.
}
